Mhuka ine ruvara rwebhuruu pamusoro pakaita pepfumbu. Inowanikwa mugungwa. Inonzi shumba yemugungwa kana kuti \sea lion\". Mhuka iyi inoratidza kutyisa."
Guta guru rinedzimba dzakaturikidzana nezvitoro zvine zvitinha zvakavakwa neruvara rutsvuku, riripedo nemugwagwa unemotikari.
Wadhiropu ine ruvara rwegireyi.Ine mikova inemibato yesimbi uye iri ye bhureki yakagara pauriri rwakasvibira.Uye rumwe rupande gwune zvekuzvuva negirazi rekuzviona.
Mhando yechirimwa chinonzi chibage.  Ichi china mavara machena, yero nepepuru.  Chakafururwa chikaunganidzwa kuita dutu.

Ngarikuni guru, gonho rakavhura maparipo ayo richiratidza kuti riri kuzvitutumadza zvaro, rakavhura nebesu kuita seshiri iya inonzi Pikoki.  Musoro waro une ruvara ruchena,  muhuro makatsvuka kuti piroo.

Nzvimbo yakapfumba inoratidza kuti inofamba veruzhinji. Nechemujinga menzvimbo iyi munemudhuri yakavakwa isina kuzopendwa asi yakapurasitwa. Yose yakapfurirwa nemazen'e uye inoratidza kuti yava nenguva yavakwa sezvo yavakusakara.
Ngetani dzemuhuro dzinoratidza chanza chemunhu.
Ruva rakasimudzwa , rakanyatsokusvibira, rinoratidza kuti ririkutengeswa sezvo rakaiswa muchipepa. Ruva iri rinoratidza kuti rinowana mwando wakakwana uye rine mufudze wakakwana.
Pane ndiro nhema ine kudya kwemandorokwati. Kudya uku kunosanganisira mbatatisi dzakabikwa zvakanaka dzikaiswa madomasi akachekererwa asina kubikwa pamusoro.
Gonzo riri kuonekwa rakafa  rine ruvara nemambava ebhurawuni nemuromo muchena. Padivi pari kuonekwa zvigaba zvakavhurika zvine ruvara rutema nemushonga wokuuraya makonzo uri mugaba reruvara ruchena.

Vanhu vari kuita zvakasiyana varume nevakadzi. Vamwe ndovarikufamba vamwe vakamira. Vamwe vakagara pazvituro vakawaridza zvinhu parutivi zviri kuratidza kuti zviri kutengeswa. Nechekumberi kuri kubuda mugwagwa uri kufamba motokari dzemhando dzakasiyana.

Munhukadzi akagara akatarisa zvinhu zvake zvaakarongedza kuti atengese. Akagara pakabhenji kezvitanda uyewo akatambanudza ruoko akaisa kuzvinhu zvaari kutengesa zvinosanganisa mafuta okubukisa uyewo mikaka inoiswa muputugadzike.
Danga rimwechete rakakura rakagadzirwa nemapuranga,waya pamwe namarata. Kuseri kune bango rakagadzirwa nesimende rinotakura waya dzinofambisa mwando wamagetsi.
Padivi pomugwagwa pane zvitoro zvikuru zvine mipanda yenhurikidzwa nemotokari dzakamira chena netema, zvitoro zvakaratidzwa namazita azvo uye mugwagwa une tara.
Mudzimai akapfeka sikipa tsvuku nechikabudura chitema ari kutora wadhirobhu iri panze mufananidzo. Wadhirobhu iyi ine mufananidzo wegireyi uye ine mibato pamagonhi ayo ine ruvara rwesirivheri.
Zvitoro zviri kutengesa zvinhu zvakasiyana siyana. Pane chimwe pari kutengeswa hembe. Pane hembe dzakaiswa muzvidhori, chikipa chitsvuku nechitirauzi chitema. Pane imwe pari kutengeswa zvemafoni.

Michero yakarongedzwa zvakanaka zvikuru yakadurikidzana. Iri kuda kuti vanhu vaone vagotenga. Uye ine ruvara rweyero rwakanaka zvikuru. Yakangosangana yakadaro inoyevedza kutarisa. Zvakarevo ikadyiwa inoita kuti miviri isimbe.
Uyo unoratidza kuti muriwo une dovi. Mune muriwo,madomasi nehanyanisi
Nzvimbo irikuratidza kuti mudhorobha netara negaraji rekumwira peturo kana dhiziri uye nemotokari nevanhu varikufamba netsoka varikuratidza kuti vamwe vacho vanotengesa.
Pane chibhorani chiripakati pedzimba dzirikuvakwa. Dzimba idzi dzirikuvakwa nezvitina uye hadzisati dzapera. Kozotiwo nechepedyo pedzimba idzi, pane mugwagwa urikupfuura nepo.

Maruva akamira akadyarwa zvakanaka aneruvara rwegirinhi, uyewo unezvivana zvainazvo zvimwe zvakaita sezvimbora.Anoyevedza kutarisa mumazizo. Uyewo maruva anogona kutanhwa achiiswa kana mudzichechi, uyewo mumba.

Mugwagwa une Tara,mujinga mawo, mune mota dzakamiswa dziri kuita majana kutaukura veruzhinji dzichiita zvemushika shika, parutivi rwemota iyi pane bhazi gur rine ruvara rweYero inoratidza kuti riri kutakura vanhu servo rakavhurwa kuBhuti kwaro riri kurongedzerwa zvinhu.

Munhandare munoitirwa mutambo wekiriketi. Zvikwata zviviri zviri kutatsurana. Vamwe vakapfeka yunifomu yeyero vamwe ndivo vakapfeka matisheti ane manyerekete egirini nemitodo mitema. Kumacheto  kwenhandare kune zvikwangwani zvinoshambadza.
Michero  yechiringu  iri yerudzi rwama strawberry yakagadzikwa mundiro iri mutsvuku.

Nzvimbo inorasirwa zvinhu nevanhu vemunharaunda.  Ine zvinhu zvakamwararika pasi.  Uyewo pane pamwe parikuoneka tsito nemadota. Kuratidza kuti pane zvakapisiwa. Izvi zvakatoita kuti masora akakomberedza atsvewo zvekare. Uyewo pane mapepa akasara  asina kutsva arikuoneka ari pasi.

Nzvimbo ine pasi pakatsemuka tsemuka pari kufamba vanhu vakawanda vangopesana vachienda mativi akasiyana. Pane motokari iripo. Pasi pemuti  pane murume akagara akazembera muti une mashizha egirinhi madiki nemumwe akamira. Pane chivakwa chine ruvara rwekirimu chine chibhakani chichena pamberi  chinoratidza kuti chitoro. Pamberi pechitoro pane vanhu vari kufamba famba.
Muti une mashizha madiki eruvara rwebumhudza uye matanda akaoma eruvara rwepfumbu akapindana pindana achivharidzira kuti mutariri arege kuona zviriseri.
Vanhu vakaungana pamusoro peguva rakavakwa nedombo dema uye pane madzimai akapfeka mabhachi matsvuku nengowanai chena nemasiketi matema neshangu tema.

Mugwagwa wakagadzirwa netara. Kurudyi rwemugwagwa uyu kune nzvimbo ine maruva nemiti yakawanda. Miti iyi nemaruva aya zvine ruvara rwegirinhi noruvara rutsvuku. Nzvimbo iyi ine zvikwangwane zvakanyorwa zvine ruvara ruchena nerutema.
Bhazi rezupco rine ruvara rwegirini nemutsetse weyero nechepakati
Mureza une ruvara rwebhuruu kumusoro uye ruvara rweyero kuzasi. Pakati pemureza uyu pane nyeredzi iripo ine ruvara rwutema.

Bhokisi guru rino shandisirwa kuchengetera hembe nevazhinji rakagadzirwa zvine unyanzvi rinozivikanwa nokuti hodhiropu. Rine mikova mitatu, miviri iri kumativi nemumwe uripakati une girazi rekuzviona kana uchisimira kana kuti uchipfeka.
Vatambi venhabvu varimubishi kutamba nhabvu, vanoratidza kuti vane shungu dzekuda kukunda. Munhandare mune vanhu vashoma vari kuona nhabvu, pasi penhandare pane huswa hwakachekerwa zvakanaka.
Apa pane chihedhibhodhi chinoiswa kumusoro  kwomubhedha. Uye nechikabhodhi chaunogona kugarira kana kuisa zvinhu mukati. Zvine ruvara rwegireyi, zvakagadzikwa pauswa hwegirini pedo nechidziro.
Danda remagetsi rine tambo ina dzinoenda dzichifuura nepamusoro pemudhuri wejuraworo wakavakwa nezvidhinha zvihombe.
Uswa unoratidza kuti wakasakurwa  uchiri hudiki we girinhi.  Parutivi pacho pane tumiti tudiki.  Sezvo inoitawo kuti nzvimbo inge  ichiratidzika uye panonayawo mvura nzvimbo isakukurwa.

Imba yakavakwa zvinomwisa mvura. Yakaiswa denga rehuswa pamusoro uyewo rakagadzirwa zvakanaka kwazvo yoita pekuti vanhu vanogara pasi vachitandara. Pamukova pane maruva maviri mamwe ari kurudyi mamwe arikuruboshwe.
Imba yakavakwa iri munharaunda inogara veruzhinji paine mumwe mudhuri wakavakwa usina kupera iine dhishi riripo panze nemacheya maviri.

Musikana akaurukwa mitsara inobva kuhuma zvichienda pamausoro. Zvozosungwa pamasoro ipapo zvimwe zvodzika pasi zvichiratidza kunaka zvikuru. Wozoiswa zvimwe zvine ruvara rwebhuru kuti zvinyatsooneka zvakanaka.
Murume akamira akasimudza maoko ake ese mudenga uye akasimudzawo  musoro  akatarisa mudenga zvakare akapfeka heti mumusoro, akapfeka sikipa isina maoko yatingati ivesi.

Zvikwenzi zviripanzvimbo yakaita kakukwirira zvikwenzi izvi panezvimwe zvinemavara egirini akasvibira poitawo zvimwe zvineruvara rwakaita kakutsvukuruka. Panematombo aripo uyewo nemiti imwe yakangosangana. Nzvimbo dzakadai vanhu vanofarira kuendapo vachinonamata havo vari vega.
Kudya, kwakaiswa mundiro chena.idzi ndiro dzakagadzikwa patafura.kudya uku kwakasiyana siyana,pane nyama,pane mupunga, pane makeroti,pane machipisi nezvimwewo.
Muti wakamoneredzwa nemidzi yemumwe muti nezvimakwenzi zvipfupi zvine mashizha ane ruvara rwegirini nechivakwa chinoratidza kuti chidzidziro chevana vechikoro.
Muti wemuchero wemumango unemashizha mahombe ane ruvara rwegirinhi. Pane mibhinana inenge  iri padyo nemumango uyu. Unoratidza kuti unamaruva okubereka ari kutanga.

Badza rinova rimwe remidziyo yakakosha inoshandiswawo pamba.Rinonyanya kushanda munguva dzekurima.Rinoitawo basa rekuchera makomba kana vanhu vachidyara,kusakura, kugadzira mihomba yembambayira kana murivo uye zvimwewo.
Vanhu vechidzimai varikumhanya munhandare. Ari kwekutanga akapfeka hembe tema nemudhebhe wegirinhi une mitsetse yewaiti mumwe wachonq akapfeka nguwani tema

Mukati mwemumwe musika,  murikutengeswa mbatatisi. Mumusika umu pane ngoro iripedyo  naamai vakagara pane chimwe chigaro. Amai ava vakasunga dhuku. Nechepadivi pavo pane murume arikufamba akapfeka hovhorosi.

Nzvimbo inoratidza kuti inorashirwa marara neveruzhinji sezvo pane marara akasiyana anosanganisira makadhibhokisi, mapepa nezvigubhi zvezvimwiwa zvakasiyana. Panzvimbo iyi pane sora rakaoma rinoratidza kuti ravane nguva risina kumbo naiwa nemvura.

Chitoro chinotengeserwa zvinhu chikuru chemuZimbabwe  chakakomberedzwa neruzhowa rwemasimbi.  Pamberi pacho pakanyorwa nezvitsvuku uye pane kanenge kamuti kegirini kari pedyo.  Masimbi ari  nechekumberi kwechitoro uyewo pane motikari dzakamira pamberi pechitoro dzakachiteedza.

Vanhu vazhinji vanosanganisira varume nevakadzi.  Vamwe vakamira vamwe vari kuratidzira kuti vari kufamba.  Vazhinji vavo vakapfeka magemenzi matema neheti tema mumusoro  dzefundo, zvichibva zvaita kuti  tifungire  kuti  vapedza   zvidzidzo zvavo  zvepamusoro zvingava zvekoreji kana zveyunivesiti.
Necheparutivi pemumwe mugwagwa pane muti uripo. Muti uyu uri pakati pemahuswa. Nechakati taramukei kwemuti uyu kune dzimba dziriko dzinoita sedziri pakati pekuvakwa.

Maruva akadzvarwa zvakanaka pachirokari. Akangosangana mamwe aneruvara rwegirini mamwewo akaita sezviuswa. Pakaiswawo zvakare chimufananidzo chechishiri chinenge dhadha chineruvara rwuchena. Poitawo chimwe chishiri chakareba chiri chimufananidzo zvakare.
Miti dzakawanda dzakareba dzinemashizha akawanda akasvibira neruvara rwegirini. Mimwe muti ine maruva aneruvara rwe pepuro.
Vanhu vakawanda madzimai nevarume vakagara pasi. Vakapfeka zvipfeko zvakasiyana. Miti yakasvibira chaizvo.
Misika ine vanhu vakawanda vari kutengesa. Umwe munhukadzi akagara pasi akapfeka ngowani tsvuku, hembe yebhuruu kumusoro, rusero, makadhibhokisi, bhaketi reyero.
Mumugwagwa wecheja, pane mumvuri webhazi riri kupfuramo. Pedyo nemumvuri uyu kune mwana anoita wechikoro akapfeka heti arikuzvifambira.
Zvuma zvakasiyana-siyana zvakaunganidzwa kuti vanhu vatenge. Zvineruvara rwakasiyana-siyana runosanganisira rwegoridhe rwebhuruu nedzimwe mhandoo dzemakara dzinosanganisira girini.
Ndiro yedanda yakapakurirwa nyama yakatsvukira zvikuru kwazvo. Nyama iyi inoratidza kuti mazondo enguruve anodaidzwa nechirungu kuti matirotasi. Pamusoro pawo pakamwaiwa mvere dzakabva pamuboora.

Nzvimbo yemuHarare ye konisitirakisheni hauzi. Pane mifananidzo yevanhu vamwe vari kupika pasi nevamwe vari kuita mabasa akasiyana-siyana.  Pane chikwangwari chekusheedzerawo nzvimboy yekuti vanhu vabhadhare kuti vashandise.

Muti muhombe une mashizha akasvibira wakamera pakati pemabwe mahombe muchikomo chine mabwe mazhinji. Pedyo nerimwe ibwe pane mutizve une mashizha mashoma akasvibira. Pakati pemabwe madoko pane huswawo hunyoro hwakasvibira.
Zvokudya zvaiswa patafura zvinoti keni rerata mune zvokunwa zvinotonhorera, parutivi pane chingwa chakaiswa nyama pamwe nembatatisi dzakakangwa uye nemuto wemadomasi.
Bhazi guru rekwa Chihwa rinonzi Chihwa 'Tours', rine ruvara ruchena , rutsvuku nemamwe ma bhokisi bhokisi ekuti rive rakanaka. Bhazi iri rine mafafitera matema uye akanaka zvikuru kwazvo.

Mashizha emuti wemubanana mazhinji acho akapfambanyuka kana ku tingati kutsemuka tsemuka icharatidza kuti anorohwa nemhepo yakanyanya.nechekumusoro kwacho tirikuona tambo refu inoratidza kuti itambo yemagetsi.

Nharaunda inogara vanhu ine tumba tupfupi. Tune matenga emaasibhesitasii pouya pamwe pane matombo pakavhurwa zvishoma nechepamberi. Kuno rumwe rutivi kune mazitombo ariko makuru kwoitawo miti yokupa mumvuri pane tumba tune matenga madiki.

Mudziyo unoshandiswa pamba. Une demo rimwe divi nepiki kune rimwe divi unonzi bhidha. Uri kuratidza kuti simbi iyi pane pairi kupiswa uyezve simbi inoratidza kuita simbi hombe yakasimba. Mudziyo uyu hauna kuiswa mupinyi . Uri pane ruvara rwegireyi.
Shumba nemwana wayo ari kumusana, yakavata pasi uye yakatarisa mberi. Kamwana kacho karikuoneka gumbo reruboshwe rakabatira pana mai vacho.
Vanhu vakamira mukati memba, vechidzimai ndivo vakamira kumberi uye vari vakawanda, kumashure kunoonekwawo munhu wemurume akapfeka hembe yeblue  akabata muchiwuno.
Sherefu yechizvino zvino inorongedzerwa ndiro mumba mekubikira yakaiswa mumba iri chena.Sherefu inoratidza kuti haina zvainazvo mairi. Uye ichiri itsva.Ine zvekukiyisa.
Mabhazi akamira rimwe pamberi rimwe mumashure nemasimbi akagadzirwa.
Fodya ine ruvara rwegirini. Shizha iri nechepakati rine ruvara rutema robva raita ruvara rweyero. Fodya yakakosha inorimwa munzvimbo dzakawanda dzakaita sana Chegutu nekumwewo kwakadero.
Munhurume ari kufamba akabereka bhegi rine ruvara rwebhuruu nebhurauni. Parutivi pane mwana musikana mudiki akamira.

Chimiro chemugwagwa wakagadzirwa ukaiswa tara. Unofamba motokari dzakasiyana siyana. Mumacheto memugwagwa uyu mune miti imwe yacho inosanganisira mijakaranda inoonekwa nemaruva ane ruvara rwepepuro. Kunozouyawo rusvingo rwakagadzirwa nesemende kumacheto.
Pedyo nemugwagwa pane zimuti ziguru rine mumvuri mudiki. Pedyo nezimuti iri pane gedhe resimbi. Nechekure kwemuti uyu kune imba yakavakwa  nezvitinha yakaiswa  mazenge pamusoro.
Uswa hwakawanda zvinotaridza kuti musango. Musango umu mune huswa hwakati kurei wakachenerukira kobva kwaita miti. Miti iyi iri kungoonekwa kuzasi kune ruvara rutema neruvara ruchana.

Vatungamiri vezvefundo vakagara panzvimbo pavarikuitira musangano. Vakapfeka mbatya dzakasiyana, vamwe vakapfeka masutu, vamwewo vakapfeka mbatya dzineruvara rwekaki. Pane umwe pakati pavo arikutaura panharunharembozha, poitawo vamwe vakagara vakabata mabhuku.

Shangu dzinopfekwa kurudyi nekuruboshwe. Dzine ruvara rwebhuruu uye dzine tutambo twakasungwa turi kuenda kumberi. Mukati madzo mutema uye kumativi kuchena. Kunze kwadzo dzine pamwe pane ruvara rwutema nerutsvuku. Dzakatetsvera zvishoma kumuromo. Imhando inopfekwa vanhu vachienda kunoita zvemutambo kana kumhanya. Dzakavharika muviri wese.

Imba yakavakwa zvakanaka. Imba huru uyewo yakaiswa zvidhinawo zvakavakisa. Zvidhina zvacho  hazvina kuiswa penda. Mumba mukati  pasi pane mataira emhando dzakasiyana. Pane mamwe anoita kutsvedzerera poita mamwe akagadzirwa nemapuranga aneruvara rwebhurawuni.

Mugwagwa mukuru une motokari dziri kufamba. Dzimwe dziri kupesana dzine ruvara ruchena. Yakaiswa tara. Pane nzira inofambwa navanhu. Zvinoratidza kuti yakapfumbira. Pane vanhu vari kufamba vari nechokumberimberi uye panoratida kuti pane panokwirirwa bhazi kana kuti panokwirirwa motokari, panogarwa navanhu pana matombo nechimuti chikuru. Nzira inofambwa navanhu iyi ine mapepa akawanda netsvina, ipo panotandarira vanhu apo vachimirira tiranisipoti.
Kudya kwakatsvetwa mundiro chena yedhaka kunosanganisira sadza jena nemuriwo wemuboora wakatsvetwa maonyeni nemadomasi.

Panodyira vana vadiki pakashongedzwa zvinonwisa mvura.Pane tafura yakaiswa mucheka muchena.Nendiro dzakaiswa zvekudyisa zvakaputirwa nemucheka.Zvigaro zviripo zvekugara ndezvamapurasitiki uye zvina mavara akasiyana.Pane makomichi ekunwira aripo patafura.Panoyevedza kutarisa.
Nzvimbo yemuguta inoonekwa sevhisi sitesheni yakanyorwa kuti Total. Nechekumashure kunoonekwa munhu wechidzimai akatakura saga pamusoro pake.

Tafura ichangobva kugadzirwa yakatotsvetwa pasi pavhu. Tafura iyi itafura dziya dzinoshandiswa mumahofisi  akasiyana-siyana. Tafura iyi iri kuratidza kuti yatozorwa mushonga  wokuti ihwinyirire pamusoro payo.
Vanhu vazhinji vari kufamba vamwe vakamira. Mukomana mumwechete akatakura zvidhori zvakakura zvitatu uye nebhegi. Pasi pane kamusika kari kutengeserwa zvekudya.

Mukomberedzo wemba wakagadzirwa nezvitinha uye nesemende. Padivi pemukomberedzo wemba uyu pane kanzira kanevhu kasina tara. Padivi pemugwagwa uyu usina tara pane miti iripo yakawanda. Imwe yakaoma imwe ine mashizha ane ruvara rwegirini.
Maruva aneruvara rwakasiyana runoti girini nepingi ayo anoita zvekudzvarwa pamba kuitira kuti pamba pakanaka uye mweya wacho unge wakanaka watinofema sezvinokudzwa.

Zvigaro zvinoshandiswa pamutambo mizhinji pamagungano zvakaturikidzaniswa. Parikuonekwa zvigaro zvinofana kunge zviri zvitatu zvakatso kurongedzwa zvakaturikidzana. Mberi kwezvigaro izvi kuri kubudikirawo chigaro chesofa.
Murume ari kutaridza kuti ari mumhepo ari kujamba asina kupfeka hembe yekumusoro.Akagerwa mumusoro.Kuzasi akasimira bhurugwa rinoita kunge rakabayirwa minhenga yeshiri.

Vadzidzi vekuchikoro che Gireti Zimbabwe vakaungana munzvimbo.  Vakapfeka mbatya dzakanyorwa zita rechikoro chavo  uye vane nguwani dzeyero pamusoro.  Pane vamwewo vari pavari vakapfeka mbatya chena dzine zvebhuruu mumaoko.  Vanoratidza kuti vane zvemutambo zvavari kuita pamwechete imomo mavakaungana uye mune vanhu vari kutotamba mutambo wemadhatsi.  Saka ivo zvinoratidza kuti vauya kuzomiririra chikoro chavo.

Mugwagwa une tara, mujinga memugwagwa uyu mune miti mikuru. Mumwe wacho une mhango pahunde yawo. Pasi pemiti iyi pane marara akasiyana anosanganisira  zvipepa nezvigubhu nesora rakaoma,  zvinobva zvaita kuti tifunge kuti inguva yechirimo kana kuti nguva yechando.

Panzvimbo pane zvimera zvakawanda. Pane nzimbe dziripo dzakabukira. Pane miti zvakare ine mashizha ane ruvara rwakasvibira rwegirini. Zvinoratidza kuti panzvimbo apa pane mvura nekuti pane tepi dziripo uye tengi remvura riri pamusoro.
Badza rakasiiwa panzvimbo isina huswa. Badza iri rine simbi kumberi uye rakarodzwa kwarino chera nako. Rine mupinyi wakareba, mupinyi wacho wakagadzirwa nemuti.
Mudhuri mukuru kwazvo wakavakwa nezvidhinha zvebhurauni. Une marata aneruvara rutsvuku uye mafafitera. Miti inemashizha aneruvara rwegirini yakakomberedza mudhuri.

Murume wechikuru unoratidza kuti uri kufambisa mumusoro akapfeka hati huru nehembe yebhuruu inemaoko marefu netirauzi rekhakhi. Nechekusure kwake kunoratidza kuti kune tara mugwagwa urikufamba motokari zhinji , nedzimwe dzakamiswa dzakarunda dzakatarisa rutivi rumwe dzakarongwa zvakanaka.
Midziyo yomumba kana kuti makabati maviri  arimuchitoro arikutengeswa. Makabati acho akapendwa nependi chena, uye akaiswa mapatani mapatani mberi, kuitira kunakisa mumba maanenge aiswa.

Chikafu chinoratidza kunaka chineruvara rwakasangana-sangana. Ruvara rwegirini, rweyero neruvara rutsvuku uyezve pane bhawera rineruvara ruchena nechikafu chebhurauni nechichena chinoratidza kuti chakaita semakeke. Parutivi panezvitsvuku uye zvinoratidza kuti michero iripo.

Motokari yakanaka ineruvara rwebhuru yakasvibira, yakashongedzwa nemachira, motokari iyi yakashongedzwa nemachira aneruvara rwepingi nemachena, nechemuzasi inejira rineruvara rwepingi neruchena zvekare.
Vanhu varimunhandare inotambirwa mutambo wezve bhora.  Vaviri uyewo pane mumwe akakotama.  Poita mumwe arikufamba akananga kune kabhora  kadiki kachena.  Uyewo pane tusimbi tutatu twakachererwa pasi.

Mharadzano dzemigwagwa isina tara. Parutivi rwacho pakamira mota chena. Nechokusure kwemota iyi kunevanhu vakagara vamwe vakamira, vazhinji vavo vakapfeka magemenzi machena zvichibva zvaita kuti tifungidzire kuti vatenderi vechipositori vari pakirawa kana kuti varipakereke havo.
Pane zvuma zvakaiswa pa tafura,  zvuma izvi zvakasiyana siyana, kusanganisira zvimwe  zve zvuma zvine ruvara rwe denga  kozoita zvimwe zvine ruvara ruchena.  Patafura iyi pakachena.
Murume mumwechete mutema, anotamba mutambo wetsiva, akabata mhenduru dzake dzekukunda.

Zvivezwa. Midziyo yokuisira zvivhitivhiti kana kuisira mabhuku nezvimwewo zvakadaro kana kuisa chikafu. Ine ruvara ruchena nerutema uyewo nemagirazi nemadhirowa ekudhonza ane ruvara rwepepuro neruvara rweyero.
Zvifananidzo zvevashandi umwe akaisa maoko mudenga,  mumwe akabata bhara  vakapfeka mahovhorosi, vakasungira  muchiuno, vakapfeka jombo, mumwe akagara pasi aine ngowani ine ruvara rwakatsvukuruka.

Dzimba dzakakomberedzwa nezvinhu zvinoyevedza zvakawanda. Idzo dzimba dzakareba uye dzakakomberedzwa nemasora akasvibira zvikuru. Poitao miti yakati chechetere yakaenzana uyeo nzvimbo yacho yakanaka kutarisa.
Zvuma zvakagadzirwa nemhando dzakasiyana uye dzine mavara akasiya zvakaungaunidzwa zvakaita zviputu zvichiendererana nemagadzirirwo, uye nemavara azvo, uye  zviri kuratidza kuti zviri kutengeswa.

Mugwagwa wakapamhamha  une tara unofamba motikari dzakasiyana dziri kuratidza kuti dziri kupesana.   Mujinga memigwagwa umu mune miti mikuru inosanganisira miJacaranda.   Pasi pemiti iyi pane sora rakaoma rinoratidza kuti rava nenguva risina kumbonaiwa nemvura.  Kune rumwe ritivi kuri kuratidza nzira inofamba veruzhinji vaya vanofamba netsoka.

Chitima chirikufamba munjanji , chitima ichi cheneruvara rwegirinhi nechokumberi chobva chaita ruvara rwutsvuku. Ichi chitima ichi chinoratidza kuva chemhandi yakudhara, uye chinogova kuva chinoshanda namarasha.

Chiteshi chakagadzirirwa vanhu kuti vagare ipapo vakamirira kukwira mabhazi nemotikari dzinouya, chakaiswa chizenge pamusoro chinoita kuti vanhu vasanaiwe kana kunzwa zuva, uye chine mapuranga ematanda akaiswa ipapo ekuti vanhu vagarisesvika chakakosha nekuti chinoita kuti vanhu vasanete kana vakamirira chekukwira.
Motokari dzakamira. Vanhu varikufamba pa pavement mumwe akabereka bhegi. Miti yemuchirungu. Mudhuri yakawanda yakavakwa yakadurikidzana

Nzvimbo yakapfumba inoratidza kuti inofambwa neruzhinji. Nzvimbo iyi inoratidza kuti inochengetedzwa sezvo pane heji yakachekererwa zvakanaka. Kune rumwe rutivi kuri kubuda miti mikuru yakasvibira nechekumberi kwacho tirikuona magumbure makuru maviri aya anodaidzwa nokunzi jojo tenki anochengeterwa mvura nevazhinji akaiswa pamusoro pe simbi.

Misha mikuru irikubuda irikuratidza kuti misha yekumamisha sezvo Imwe yacho yakavakwa zvisina kunyatsa  kunaka ikapfirirwa neuswa. Nechekumberi kwacho kurikubuda michero yakawanda yakasiyana  inosanganisira mi banana nemigereko.
Imba yakanaka uye yakaiswa mataira pamusoro. Yaka nyatsopendwa zvakanaka ndokuiswa rusvingo kunze. Pakasimwawo maruva nemiti.

Mune akarongedza zvinhu zvake zvekutengesa pasi mudhorobha,pane maonyeni arikuoneka nemadomasi matsvuku akaiswa pasagajena,uye munhu arikumatengesa akagara pamusoro pechikadhibhokisi pedyo naye pane chimwe chinoratidza kuti pane umwe anogaravo zvekare achitengesa zvinhu zvake.
Bhuku rimwechete rinoshandiswa navana vaduku pakuita kana pakunyora masvomhu. Rineruvara rwebhuruu muiri wese. Pamberiwo panemufananidzo uripo wevana musikana nemukomana uyewo pane mavara aripo.

Vanhu vazhinji vakagara pazvituro vanosanganisira varume nevakadzi. Nechekumberi tirikuona mukadzi akapfeka uye akazvishongedza chose. Arikudya chikafu chinosanganisira mupunga nenyama yakatsvukira. Akabata forogo neruwoko rwake rwerudyi.
Pamberi pemumwe musha urikuvakwa usati wapera, pane jecha romurwizi. Jecha iri rakakomberedzwa nezvitina, nechemberi kwezvitina izvi kune uswa hudiki.

Mharadzano dzemugwagwa dzinoratidza kuti  une tara.  Uye mugwagwa uyu unoratidza kuti wava nenguva yakareba wagadzirwa sezvo uchiratidza kusakara nekusharuka. Une makomba  kunyanya  mujinga mawo,  nechekurutivi  kwacho tiri kuona miti mikuru yakasvibira chose.
Vanhu vakawanda vari panzvimbo yekutengesera pane murume akabata zvidhori zviviri chimwe chitsvuku chimwe chebhuruu akaisa tambo muhuro akatarisana nemukadzi akapfeka jazi jena nedhirezi dzvuku.
Mudzimai werudzi rwechitema akamira padivi pemugwagwa usina tara akatarisa vanhu varimhiri. Mudzimai uyu akapfeka ngohwani ineruvara ruchena. Akapfeka sikipa nesiketi zvineruvara ruchena zvakare.
Musoro werori, gonyeti muchena. Kumashure kune miti nemakore mashoma mudenga netanga rokuisira mafuta.
Bani kana kuti tingati nzvimbo yakakomberedzwa newaya, mukati menzvimbo iyi munoratidza kuti maiva nesora zhinji ranga raoma sezvo makapiswa mukasara masidzi nemazimbe.

Vakomana vakamira munhandare vose vakabata zvifuva zvavo. Vanoratiza kuti vakapfeka zvipfeka zvokutambisa mutambo wenhabvu. Zvine ruvara rwakafanana kusiya kweumwe wakapfeka zvipfeko zvine ruvara ruri rwega.

Mureza una mavara akasiyana -siyana. Tichibva kuzasi tichienda kumusoro, unotanga neruvara ruchena kouya ruvara rwe bhuruu kouya ruvara ruchena zvekare kouya ruvara rwe bhuruu zvichingodaro.  Nechekuruboshwe kune ruvara rwe yero inoratidza kuti  pane mufananidzo uripo.
Vanhu vatatu vari kutengesa mafuta ekuzora anotsvukisa. Mumwe mudzimai akapfeka heti nemask.
Imbwa imwe chete yakakura ine ruvara rwebhurawuni nerutema pamhuno yayo, parutivi pane chigaro chakagadzirwa nemuti rumwe rutivi mugwagwa.
Iri idandemutande rine makumbo masere rine ruvara rwebhurawuni nemavara mavara matema. Makumbo ekumberi marefu kudarika epakati nekumashure.
Nzvimbo inevhu nejecha rakawanda. Ivhu remunzvimbo iyi rine ruvara rutema uye, nzvimbo iyi inoratidza kuti hainaye mvura yakawanda nekuda kwekuoma kwakaita pasi.
Mukadzi ari kufamba mumugwagwa  akapfeka dhirezi refu . Achifamba padhuze neimba.
Apa ndirikutoona panenge pachuru apa, pachuru hapana chinonyanyisa kuwanzo mera zvakanyanya zvinoenda mberi.Pane uswa ushomaneni nokuti churu chemajuru anenge achitotsvaga chikafu achidya chikafu.
Mugwagwa une kurutivi kune makomo ane matombo nemiti yegirini.

Dzimba dzakavakwa dzakatevedzana panzvimbo imwe chete. Dzine matenga ane ruvara rwakasiyana asi dzakavakwa zvakafanana. Dziri munzvimbo ine miti yakareba ine mapazi akawanda namashizha anoruvara rwegirini.

Vanhu varikuratidza kuti varimumba varikuimba. Mumba umu mune firiji dhipifuriza riripo uye rakagara mumba mune mataira. Nechekumusoro kwavo kunehwindo riripo kuratidza kuti panze paneimwe imba iripo yemapuranga. Mavakagara imba hombe, vakagara pazvituru vamwe varikuridza hosho vamwe ngoma vamwe mbira nevamwewo vakawanda. Vanhurume varikuimba.
Uswa hwakawanda huri panzvimbo imwe chete. Uswa uhwu hwakareba uye hune ruvara rwebhurawuni. Zvinoratidza kuti nzvimbo iyi haisi kuwana mvura yakawanda nokuti uswa hwakaoma.

Mufananidzo wakaitwa zvine unyanzvi uyo wakanyorerwa mubhuku rina mapepa machena ane mitaro munhukadzi akanyorwa uyu ane vhudzi hombe akapfeka hembe isina maoko otiwo mudhebhe akabata rushaya rumwe ruoko rwakabata gumbo.

Ruzhinji rwevanhu rwunosanganisira  vanhukadzi nevanhurume vari kuita bhindauko rekutengesa zvekupfeka zvinosakanisira neshangu nemhumbi. Izvo zvinoita kuti vanhu vange vachiwanawo zvekupfeka zvinenge zvakachipa. Zvinotumidzwa zita rekuti bhero.

Machira ane ruvara vara anowanzo shandiswa nemadzimai kumonera anonzi mazambiya, machira aya ane mavara akasiyana siyana uye akapetwa zvakanaka rimwe riri kuratidza kuti rakagadzirwa kuti riburitse chipfeko chemukadzi chekumusoro.

Shangu dzechidzimai mbiri dzakatsvetwa pasi dzinoratidza kuti dzinoruvara rutema pamusoro padzo uye nechemberi kunosvika zvikunwe zvetsoka kana dzichinge dzakapfekwa. Neruvara rwakacheneruka mukati madzo.
Musika unotengeswa zvikafu, mamwe mafuta ane mivharo yeyero. Murume akagara pasi akapfeka hembe ine mara nechekumusoro. Ngowani tema, masiki pamuromo netirauzi tema.

Vakoma vaviri vanoratidza kuti vanoita zvekusimudza simbi, vakomana ava vakapfeka hembe dzinosiya maoko dzinosiya mhasuru dziri  panze. Mumwe akapfeka hembe uneruvara rwebhuru mumwe ndiye akapfeka hembe inoruvara rweyero.
Pamadziro emumwe musha panechigaro chesimbi chakasakara chiripo. Chigaro ichi chakatenderedzwa netutombo. Uyezve pamberi pacho panemavhu anoita semajecha.

Vanhu varikufamba mumugwangwa inowanikwa mukati medhorobha reHarare.Pane motikari dziripo dzimwe dzakapakwa poitavo dzimwe dzirikufamba pakati pemugwagwa miviri pane miti yakadzvarwa zvakanaka uyewo vanhu varikufamba vamwe vakaisa zvivhara dzihwa vazhinji vacho.Pane vanhukadzi vakatakura mabheki poitavo mukomana,pane vamwe varikufamba vakafuratira varikuuya nechekumberi.

Bundo zhinji rakasvibira riya rinonyanya kumera  pamusoro pemvura.  Riri kubwinya ririkuratidza kuti rinowana mwando wakakwana Sezvo riri pamusoro pemvura .  Mujinga macho mune muti mukuru wakasvibira wakatumbuka maruva matsvuku akanaka anobwinya  anoratidza kuti anokwezva nyuchi nemazingizi.
Chiringa zuva chakaiswa muzvigunwe zvitatu , nezvinwe zviringazuva gumi nemasere zvirimuchigaba mazvo  chine ruvara rutema .

Mugwagwa unofamba dzimotokari uripakati pedhorobha. Izvo zvirikuonekwa nezvivakwa zvirimurutivi narwo. Zvakakura chaizvo zvinoratidza kuti zvinamakamuri akawandisa anoshandirwawo nevanhu mabasa akasiyana siyana.
Dzimba dzakagadzirwa zvakanaka. Dzakavakwa dzakapfirirwa nehuswa. Dzakagadzirwa panzvimbo ine miti yakawanda nemaruva akakomberedza.

Nzvimbo inorasirwawo marara pasi payo zvakare inehuswa pamwechete netsanga dzirikumerawo dzichikura dziri panzvimbo apa. Tsanga idzi dzirikuratidza kuti dzirikuwana mvura yakakwana sezvo dziine mashizha adzo akanyatsakuita girinhi.

Mugwagwa unofambawo dzimotokari dzichienda kwakasiyanasiyana uye zvakare mudivi kwomugwagwa uyu kune zvivakwa zviriko zvinoratidzawo kuve dzimba kana zvimwewo. Pamberi pezvivakwa izvi pakadyarwawo miti pamwe chete nemaruva okushongedza nzvimbo iyi.
Dzimba nhatu dziri pamufunanidzo yeuswa iri pedyo, uye ine imwe nzvimbo isisisna huswa inoda kugadziriswa. Mwana arikutamba nematayi arikufamba achibva pamatayi. Marara akaraswa-raswa pachivanze.
Maturuzi anoshandiswa kugadzira mudziyo yemumba akagadzikwa pasi, maturuzi aya akagadzirwa nesimbi uye ane mubato wepuranga.
Nzvimbo inoratidza kuti idhorobha pane zvivakwa nepakagadzirwa pekupakira mota pakapaka mota ipapo nepakamira mumwe murume pakagadzirwa zvakanaka pane ruva regirinhi neroni yegirinhi.
Chaunga chavanhukadzi vanoratidza kuti vari pamusangano. Vanogona kunge vari vechechi yeZCC ndiyo inopfeka yunifomu yakadayi.
Imba yakapfirirwa nehuswa. Ine chekurasa hutsi padenga payo. Kumberi yakavakwa nema(tile). Uyewo ine pekuisira rambi kana kuti(light) padenga paro.
Imba yakavakwa nezvidhinha nesemende. Ine denga rine ruvara rutema. Chidziro chemba iyi chine ruvara ruchena uye kuzasi kune ruvara rutsvuku. Imba iyi ine mafafitera maviri nemukova mumwe chete.
Munhukadzi akamira pakati pemvura. Akatakura gate rine mvura yaari kudurura murwizi. Uyewo maoko ake akashongedzwa nezvuma. Zvakarewo ane zvimwe zvuma muhuro make. Bvudzi rake rakakura uye idema.
Muti womugondekonde wakareba. Urimusangohombe rine miti inemashizha akasvibira uye rinesora rakasvibira nerimwe rakaoma.

Mune imwe ndiro ine ruvara rutema makaiswa chikafu chemhando yepamusoro. Chikafu ichi chinosanganisira mbatatisi uye nyama yakatsvukira. Mundiro imwe chete munoita semune muriwo uye hanyanisi dzisina kuchekerwa.
Patafura pane ndiro yebhonzo ine nyama yakabikwa zvakanaka ine muto wakatsvuka. Parutivi pane muriwo une ruvara rwegirinhi namatomatisi akachekwa.
Buwe rine muviri unemutarazi mitema nemipfumbu riri kufamba paivhu makumbo aro akakwirira kudarika mutumbi, mutumbi uzere nemvere pamwechete nemakumbo ayo.
Miti dzakawanda dzakakura. Umwe una maruva  akawanda ane ruvara rwepepuro. Pasi pane uswa hwakawanda uye hwakaoma  hune ruvara rwebhurauni.
Musitoro munotengeswa maphone nezvimwe zvese zvinogona kushandiswa pa phone. Uyewo pane mukadzi ari kutengesa akasunga dhuku chena uye ari kusekerera.
Komichi yekushongedzwa mumba yakabatwa. Inemavara-mavara  machena, bumhudza koita zvakare goridhe. Nechekumusoro kwayo kuneruvara rutsvuku rwakaikomberedza.
Masora emutsanga akamira akasangana nezvimwewo. Uyewo ane ruvara rwegirinhi uyewo pane mimwe mitsanga yatosimba poita imwe ichiri mitetetete. Pane zvimwewo zvimatombo zviri kuoneka zviri pakati payo.
Munda wakarimwa ma cabbage akawanda.  Ma cabbage aya ana mashizha  makuru uye ane ruvara rwe girinhi.  Mudenga mune tambo dzamagetsi dzirikupfuura nepakati pemunda uyu.
Muti wakavakwa pamberi pechivakwa chiri kuita kunge chikuru chine mukova nedhoo jena nemahwindo akawanda.

Nechekumucheto kweumwe mugwagwa unofamba motokari kune motokari dzakamirako. Nechemberi kwemugwagwa uyu kurikuratidza kuti kune dzimba dzemudurikidzwana. Pakati pemugwaga uyu pane vanhu varikufambapo.

Iyi nzvimbo inoratidza kuti inzvimbo inotengeswa zvinhu zvakasiyana siyana zvinosanganisa mabhanana, mbatya nemasagi. Uyewo panemunhu arikufamba hake achitengesa zvidhori. Uyewo vanhu varikungozvifambira zvavo, vamwe ndovarikuda kutenga

Nzvimbo yakanyatsoshongedzwa inoratidza kuti pane muchato.Panzvimbo iyi pane mabharuma akashongedzwa zvine hunyanzvi.Mabharuma aya ane ruvara ruchena mamwe ane ruvara rwebhuru koitawo mamwe ane ruvara rwakarerekera kupingi yakachenerukira.Nechemukati kunoratidza kuti kune tafura yakanyatsoshongedzwa chaizvo.
Mota dzirifamba mumugwagwa, pasi panemarara. Dzineruvara rwesirivha nemutsara webhuruwu. Irimberi ineruvara rwemeruni uye mavhiri matema. Padivi nechekurudyi, pane kadhibhokisi rakabvaruka mberi.
Zviumbwa zvemibato yemaoko zvinodaidzwa nezita rokunzi mbiya. Mbiya dzaka turikidzaniswa dzimwe dziri Ina ina dzimwe dziri shanu shanu.
Mupunga nenyama zvakabikwa zvinoyevedza, zvakasanganiswa pamwe chete madomasi nehanyanisi zvakashandiswa kubika muto wenyama unonaka mupunga wakachena kuti ngwee kunge mukaka.
Zvivakwa zviri. Chimwe chakavakwa neruzhowa rwakagadzirwa nesimende. Chinamafafitera maviri. Chimwe chakavakwa nezvitina chine ruvara rwekirimu.
Tumiti twakachenukira twumwe tune ruvara rwebhurauni twune mashizha maduku aneruvara rwegirini inekayero.Pazvimbo iyi pane twumashizha twakawanda twakadonha twune ruvara rwebhurauni.

Nyati huru inoratidza kuti ibhuru yakadambuka imwe nyanga yekudivi  rwekuruboshwe ichiratidza kuti inenge yairwa neimwe ikadamburwa nyanga.  Nyati iyi ine kumeso kwakaunyana nemuviri wakafuta ine ruvara rwakasviburuka uye zheve dzacho dzakabvarurwa kuratidza kuti yairwa.
Shangu mbiri dzeruvara rwe gireyi. Hadzisungwi netambo pamusoro, dzine chibhandi chekudzishongedza. Mukati madzo makandoita gireyi yakasvibira.  Dzaka dhirowewa zvimoyo kumashure kwadzo kunodzika.
Vanhu vakagara pamusha urikuvakwa. Padivi pemusha uyu pane miti miviri yemumango yakareba, uye miti iyi ine mashizha akawanda ane ruvara rwegirini.
Pamusika parikutengeswa mbatatisi. Mudzimai wakamira akapfeka hapuroni yakati chenerukire nemurume wakapfeka hembe tsvuku nebhachi rine ruvara rwedenga risina makore.
Mureza une mavara matatu akasiyana.  Ruvara ruri pazasi rutema. Ruvara ruri pakati ruchena. Ruvara ruri padenga rutsvuku.

Mureza unomiririra imwe nyika unoratidza kuti unemutaro mutsvuku unobva kumusoro kusvikira zasi. Kozoita mamwe mavara anosanganisira ruvara rwamashizha nanyoro divi rokumusoro. Kozoita ruchena pakati uye ruvara rutema divi rezasi.
Mune imwe nzvimbo pane vanhu vakamira pamberi pengoro inotengesa zvinwiwa. Umwe wavarume akamira apa akapfumba maoko. Kwozoti nechekumberi kwavo kune imwe mota yakavhura gonhi.
Mufananidzo wegava wakaiswa pabhuku pachishandiswa penzura unoratidza musoro nechipfuva chete chete.
Ruzhowa rwakashongedzwa rune mudhuri wakaiswa ruvara rwakajeka ruchena muviri wese netukirimu. Panewo gedhi rakaiswa ruvara ruchena nesimbi dziri pamusoro paro dzine ruvara ruchena.

Nzvimbo yakakomberedzwa ne waya. Mukati menzvimbo iyi mune muti mukuru wakakombodza wakasvibira . Muzasi memuti uyu munoratidza kuti unogarwa nevanhu vakazorara zvavo vachitonhorerwa nemubvuti wemuti uyu. Sezvo wakakombodza wakasvibira chose.
Kurutivi kwemugwagwa uri kufamba motokari, kune sumburera dzakavhara musika pedyo pemisika iyi pakamira bhazi dzvuku rakanyorwa padumbu, kozoti necheparutivi pebhazi iri  pane chikwangwani.
Murume mumwe chete akamira akabata bhora muruoko rwake. Mutambi webhora remumaoko. Akapfeka yunifomu yebhuruu ine mavara machena. Shure kwake kune motokari dzakamira.
Pane vanhu vakagara parukukwe kozoita mumwe mudzimai akapfugama parukukwe iroro achigadzika chikafu chikafu ichi chakapakurirwa mundiro dzedongo chimwe chezvikafu zviripo magaka Asina minzwa

Motikari nhatu dzakapakwa kumashure kwemajojo tank maviri. Pane motokari wo yehonda fit, toyota wish ne probox. Zvinoratidza kuti vanhu vakapaka motokari idzi varikuchera mvura inobva mumajojo tank aya anoshandisa mahinjini kupomba mvura.
Komicho yegirazi inetumapundu mapundu kumativi asina kusvika kumusoro. Ine chimubato.  Yakagara pamusoro  pezvimubato zvemapanga. Irimushopu mune midziyo yemumba neimwe yepurasitiki.
Amai vakabata ruva vachiripfekedzera paakaungana vachinyemwerera vakabata muchiuno, pedo pavo pane vamwe vakamira vakatarisa.
Pane munhu anoratidzika somunhurume ari pekati pemamwe maruva akamurebera. Murume uyu akakotama akabata heti uyezve akapfeka hembe nomudhebhe.

Mugwagwa wetara. Kuruboshwe kune service station yakanyorwa kunzi Total Energies. Kumberi kunoonekwa dzimotokari dzakawanda dzirimumugwagwa uyewo kurudyi kwemugwagwa kunoonekwa masolar anoshandisa zuva.
Vanhu varikusimudza tutsapo twavo kubva pamusika apa vachienda kunzvimbo dzakasiyana-siyana. Ngoro mbiri dzakasendekwa kuita chamupidigori.
Nzvimbo yakagadzirwa yakanaka chose ine miti namaruva zvakachekererwa zvakaenzana, uye zviri zverudzi rwe girini zvakapfumvutira pane nzira yakasiiwa yokufamba nayo yekuti undobuda nekugedhi.
Rimwe divi remudhorobha.  Rine midhuri ine mahofisi akasiyana-siyana. Mimwe mirefu mimwe mipfupi.
Ndiro dzematanda dzakaiswa chikafu chakasiyana chinosanganisira matomatisi akachekerwa zvakanaka nezvimanhanga zvidoko zviya  zvinodaidzwa  nevazhinji kuti bhata nati

Vanhu vagere pazvigaro. Vamwe vanenguwo chena vamwe zvitsvuku. Arikurudyi anenguwani ichena mumusoro make. Vanoratidza kuti vane zvarikunyora pamapepa, aripakati akabata chinyoreso. Varikumashure vakataririra munhu arikutaura arimberi, uye kune miti nesora.
Pamharadzano yemigwagwa,pane motokari dziripo kusanganisira imwe nhema.Nechokunze kwomigwagwa,kune zvikwangwani zvakati wandeyi zvakaiswa.Zvikwangwani izvi,zviri pedyo nechidziro.
Mirongo miviri yemavise,mavise maviri mahombe.Vise iri rine ruvara rwegirini uyezve rine mitsara inotevedza vise iri yakasvibirira.Rimweni racho rakachekwa mukati maro mutsvuku  nemhodzi dzichena.

Chitima chiri munjanji. Chine ruvara rwegirini noruvara rutsvuku. Muna vanhu vakaburitsa musoro nepahwindo. Pane mudoko mwana akaburitsa musoro nepahwindo ari kumberi, kwoita wechikuru muchena wakaburitsa musoro nepahwindo zvakare.
Muti wakamera pakati pematombo,  muti werudzi  rwemunzwa unamashizha akasvibirira.  Matombo aya akakura chose uye akapatsanuka akati rimwe uko rimwe uko.
Sora rakasiyana siyana rakawanda rine ruvara rwegirinhi uye rakanatsosvibira. Parutivi pane mudhuri uneruvara ruchena.

Vanhu vakufamba zvavo mujinga mezvidhori zvakapfekedzwa hembe itsva dzirikuratidza kuti dzirikutengeswa. Pavanhu apa pane murume akapfeka heti nechivhara mhino chiya chinoshandiswa kudzivirira dzimbwa rekorona. Akapfeka mudhembe mutema nesikipa tema inemaoko mapfupi.

Mufananidzo wemukomana akapfeka chikabudura chitema kumusoro ane mbatya chena netsvuku. Ane chuma muhuro akapfeka zviwoneso zvinopfekwa nevanhu vanorwadziwa nemaziso.

Mumba yokutandarira. Mune zvigaro zvakakura. Zvakagadzirwa namatehwe zvitatu zvinoonekwa netafura yedenderedzwa iripakati.

Munhu ari munhandare arikuratidza kuti arikutsigira mutambo. Akasimudza mureza unoratidza kuti ndewemhando yedivi raanotsigira. Kumashure kwake pane chikwangwari chiri kutengesao mabhodhoro edhiringi rinonzi Pepsi. Murume uyu ane musoro une rasita.

Munhu akabata mukombe akamusimudza mudenga kuratidza kuti arikupemberera kukunda makwikwi kwavanenge vaita vakawana mukombe uyu.Vakapfeka hembe inemaoko marefu yakaita chena uye akaisa menduru muhuro.
Miti iri kubudikira ine mashizha egirinhi. Jurahoro rakavakwa nezvidhinha zvebhurawuni, masimbi akapendwa nebhuruu.
Ngoro yakatakura mapuranga yakamira pakati pemugwagwa. Nechekunze kwemugwagwa kune imba yemapuranga inoratidza kuti haina gonhi kana fafitera. Pasi pengoro iyi pane marara.

Munhu kadzi akapfeka hembe ine ruvara rwe pingi yakanyorwa pamberi nezvichena.Musoro wake wakarukwa mabhuraidzi ane ruvara rutema ayo akarembera achidzika nemumapfudzi.Munzeve dzake mune mhete.

Muchinjiko, parutivi pane munhu akamira akasimudza maoko. Kurikouneka zuva riri kupenya richipenyera pamuchinjiko uyu.

Varume vanoita zvekutamba mitambo. Mutambo uyu unoratidza kuva mutambo webhasiketibho. Varume varipo vakapfeka umwe wakapfeka nhumbi dzebhuruu neshangu chena. Mumwe wacho achibva apfeka zvisho zvipfeko zveyero neshangu tema. Pane vanhu vakawanda varikuratidza kunge varikutamba mutambo.

Mugwagwa wakapamhama une tara mumugwagwa umu muri kufamba mota dzakasiyana dzine marudzi akasiyana dzimwe itsvuku dzimwe ichena kusanganisira bhazi rekwa c.a.g rine kumberi kwakaita kuchena nekumasure kwakaita girini nechekumberi kwacho tiri kuona miti mikuri yakasvibira yemupaini.

Panzvimbo pakatimbiwa timbiwa pane sora riripo, apo pakatimbiwa  pakaisiwa mupfudze, panoratidza kuti ibindu ririkugadzirwapo, vanhu vanodyara murivo kana miti mumapindu.

Varume vatatu vanoratidza kuti ndevechikuru vakamira. Vose vakapfeka midhebhe michena nemahembe anemaoko mapfupi anoruvara rwakaita ruchena. Umwe wacho akabata tsvimbo neruoko rwake rworudyi.

Mukomana mumwe chete wechidiki wechitema akafuratira. Akapfeka nhumbi dzine ruvara rwegirini uye yakanyorwa kumusana neruvara ruchena. Padivi pane ngoro dziripo uyezve kumberi kwake kune vanhu varikufamba.
Motokari dzirikufamba mumugwagwa.  Imwe yerudzi hweHwonda fiti. Inoruvara ruchena. Miti inemaruva aneruvara rwepepo. Motokari ine ruvara rwesirivha.

Ndiro yakagadzikwa pamusoro petafura. Ndiro iyi ine ruvara ruchena uye yakapakurirwa chikafu chakabikwa zvemandorokwati. Mune hove yakakangwa ikatsvukirira uyewo mune maavho, matomatisi, mbatatisi, mupunga nezvimwewo zvinonaka.
Pane mukadzi ari kufamba mune imwe nzira ine vanhu vakawanda akabereka mwana. Mukadzi uyu anoita kunge akabata zvinwiwa zviri mupepabhegi kune rumwe ruoko.
Mufananidzo wemaruva akadyarwa nesora riri kuwonekawo mukati akasiyana siyana ane mavara egirini mamwe akati svavirireyi arikuwoneka powo.
Tenisi rine ruvara rutsvuku mukati nekunze rine rabha rine ruvara ruchena rine kabhadhe pamusoro ndere kugumbo rerudyi tenesi ishangu inopfekwa kuchitonhora.
Mabhegi akasiyana siyana ane mavara akasiyana siyana zvakare. Mamwe mabhegi ane ruvara rutsvuku mamwe ndoane ruvara ruchena namavara matema. Koitawo mamwe ane ruvara rweyero neruvara rutema.
Mumugwagwa munofamba motokari duku. Parutivi pomugwagwa pane mabhazi mairi akamira. Rimwe ritsvuku rine mavara eyero nematema. Rimwe richena rine mavara ebhuruu.

Mudzimai ari kufamba mujinga memudhuri mukati medhorobha. Akapfeka nguwo yekumusoro ine ruvara rutsvuku uye siketi ine mavara akawanda anosanganisira girinhi, bhuru uye ruvara rutema.

Panzvimbo inoiita seyemusika pane vanhu vakawanda vari kufamba murume akatakura saga rembatatisi,kozoitawo amai vakapfeka heti, kozotiwo nechekumberi kwemurume uyu kune  kune tambo dzemagetsi.

Shangu mbiri dzechikadzi dziri muruvara rwebhurawuni. Dzakatsvetwa pauriri. Imwe yacho inopfekwa kudivi rokurudyi imwe ichipfekwa kugumbo rekuruboshwe.

Nechekumberi kwacho tirikuona midhuri mikuru yakanaka zvinobva zvaita kuti tizive kuti nzvimbo iyi iri mukati medhorobha.

Mushina unoshandiswa mumakicheni kugadzira aizikirimu. Unemagaba maviri rimwe rine aizikirimu ineruvara rweyero, rimwe rine ineruvara rutsvuku. Unotsimbirira zvisimbi zvesirivha kuti aizikirimu ibude.

Munhandare yebhora revakadzi mune vatambi varikutamba vakapfeka zvipfeko zvineruvara rwemvura nezvipfeko zvitsvuku. Nhandare yakakomberedzwa nevawokeri vakazara kumacheto.

Nzvimbo yezvekutengeserana ine mabhanana akaibva zvikuru ane ruvara rwegoridhe uye nechepamberi pemabhanana panoratidzira mbatya dzakaiswawo ipapo dziri kutengeswa uye muzvina bhizimusi akagara pasi pamubvuri akamirira vatengi kuti vauye kuzotenga.

Mashizva zviri musango zvakamira  zvakango mwararika . Pane zvimwe zvakarerekera neche kuritivi rwerudyi, kuratidza kuti mhepo iri kuzvitora zvakarerekera ikoko, koitawo zvimwe zvipfupi zvakango mora zvisiri kuratidza kwazva karerekera.

Mubhuku mune mufananidzo wechiso chemunhukadzi, akagadzirwa musoro zvakanaka. Wakaiswa nechinyoreso chitema.

Mugwangwa unetara, munjinga memugwagwa uyu mune miti mikuru inoratidza kuti yave nemakore yamera sezvo yakombodza yakomba.Munjinga macho zvekare mune mudhuri unoratidza kuti wakakomberedza nzvimbo kana musha.

Miti mizhinji iri parutivi pomumugwagwa. Uyezve pane karodhi kari pakati pemudhuri nemiti apo vanhu pavanofamba kuitira kuti vange vasingatsikwe nedzimotokari dzinenge dzichifamba dziri mumugwagwa dzichienda kudhorobha  dzimwe dzichibvako.
Varume vaviri vakapfeka zvipfeko zvemutambo. Mubhedhe mitema, nhumbi dzekumusoro dzineruvara rwenhengeni rwakasvibira, netubhachi tutema tusina maoko.
Mumugwagwa wetara mune bhazi riri kufamba rine ruvara rwegirini uye rine zvichena padumbu pamberi pane motikari iri kufamba parutivi pane ivhu rakatsvukuruka nemumvuri wemiti iri kune rimwe rutivi.

Vanhu varikufamba mumugwagwa unowanikwa mudhorobha, pane vamwe vari kufamba nechekunze vaviri, koitawo vamwe vari kuda kuyambuka mugwagwa kuenda kune rumwe rutivi, pedyo navo pane mota ine ruvara rwebhuruu uyewo kune zvivako zvakareba zviri kuenda mudenga kudivi kune mota.
Vanhu vakamira padivi remugwagwa vakafuratira zvitoro, pane varume nemukadzi akabata mwana mumaoko nevamwe varikutengesa zvinwiwa.

Nzvimbo inojenga mvura. Ina mahuswa nebundo. Uye necheparutivi panoratidza kuti pane ruwara. Pane matombo aneruvara rwakachenerukira neruvara rwutema. Pobva paita tsangadzi iripo ine mashizha ineruvara rwegirinhi. Necheparutivi pane bundo riripo rineruvara aneruvara rwegirinhi rweginhi zvakare.

Shangu yemunhukadzi yekuruboshwe ine ruvara rwenhundurwa, mukati ine ruvara rwakachenerukira asi kumberi kwayo ine ruvara rwenhundurwa nechemukati imomo, yakashama kumashure nekumberi pamusoro ine tusimbi tune ruvara rwegoridhe.
Gomo rine miti ye girinhi yakasvibira zvikuru kwazvo. Muzasi megomo iri mune chikoro chakapendwa neruvara rwe yero. Panzvimbo iyi pane mitiwo  zvakarewo pachikoro nezvimigwagwa zvinoshandiswa nevana.

Mudziyo wekuisa mbatya une ruvara rutema nezvekubatisa zvitema uchiwanikwa mumba yekurara
Dheka ndiro yesimbi ine mupendero mutema. Ine mibato miviri rutivi nerutivi. Inoratidza kuti ine zifa remukaka jena mukati nechivharo chakavhurwa chandosendekedzwa padivi pedheka iri.

Musoro wemunhu kadzi anevhudzi rakagadzirwa. Rakagadzirwa zvakaisvonaka vhudzi. Rine ruvara rutema, ipfupi zvekusvika  munzeve. Munhukadzi akagadzirwa uyu  akapfeka bhurauzi rine mavara ebhuruu nematsvuku.

Pane mombe dzingangosvika idzo shanu dziri kufura pane rimwe gura riri mujinga megomo. Mombe idzi dzine mavara anosanganisira matema kwozouya dzimwe tsvuku. Pedyo negura iri pane makomo ari nechekure.

Nyama yenguruve inoratidza kuti ichangourawa. Yakaputirwa nerupepa runoonekwa zviri mukati uye yakaiswa chipepa chakanyorwa kuratidza mutengo wacho.
Maruva ane ruvara ruchena. Mashizha ane ruvara rwegirini uye ane ruvara rwakatsvukuruka.

Ruoko rwemunhu arikuratidza kuti ane mutambo waari kutamba. Uye arimunhandare. Munhu uyu akapfeka hembe yeruvara rwuchena uye aonratidza kuti mutsvuku. Nechekumashure kwake kune zvinhu zvakabuda zvakaita semadziro zvitema zvine mitaro michena.
Matombo nemiti ine mashizha akasvibira. Matombo akawanda arikwekutanga kumberi kunoonekwa mashoma. Kune mabukirao mumuti anova machena.
Vanhu vari mukati mechivakwa pane munhukadzi akasungira zambiya rinobva kumapendekete, uyewo kune vamwe vakamira varikuona zvimwe zvirimowo zvakasiyana zvinosanganisa ngoma yakakakiwa zvakanaka.
Murume arikutamba achijamba mudenga akasimudza maoko ake akatarira mberi. Murume uyu haana chaakapfeka kumusoro uye akapfeka siketi inoita kunge makushe.
Musango mune miti mihombe neimwe midiki. Nechekumberi kwemiti iyi kune mapundo madiki-diki nematombo akangozara-zara pose.

Mudzimai arikufamba kumashure kwevanhu varikufamba mudhorobha vari mujinga memudhuri. Mudzimai uyu akapfeka hembe yekumusoro ine ruvara rwekirimu nesiketi ine ruvara rwepinki. Kurudyi kwake kune motikari dzakapaka mujinga memugwagwa.
Pane miti yakasiyana iripo, miti iyi inosanganisira imwe ine maruva matsvuku kozoita mukonde uri pedyo. Pane mumwe muti uripadyo une mashizha akasvibira.
Shangu mbiri dzakavharika dzerudzi ruya rwekuti tsepete pasi. Ndedzemativi ose ekurudyi nekuruboshwe. Dzineruvara rwebhurauni muviri wese.
Muchero unowanikwa musango unonzi nyii unodyiwa navanhu, vachidya makwande vachisvipa mhodzi. Unodyiwa zvekare nemhuka, makudo neshiri dzemusango.
Shiri mbiri dzakafanana dzineruvara rwunoti nhema bhuruu uye muromo nehuma tsvuku . Pasi panesora rakawanda rakasvibira regirini.
Mombe dzakamira. Dziri pedo nerwizi dzimwe chichinwa mvura dzimwe dzichiita sedzinoda kupinda pedo nerwizi. Pane miti ine mashizha akaoma.
Mabhazi maviri akamira pachiteshi mumadhorobha vanopati parengi panotaridza kuti akamira panzvimbo dzekuti vanhu vauye vazokwira ipapo. Iwo anenge akazorora ipapo achimirira vanhu.
Mukomana akapfeka nguwo tema, aneshangu chena dzine tsvunho yeNike mutsoko akapakatira chibheke chineruvara rwebhurauni. Akamira akaisa maoko ake muhomwe.
Motokari dzirikufamba mukati momugwagwa. Kudivi kwemugwagwa uyu kunezvikwangwani zvekushambadzira zviripadenderedzwa remugwagwa.
Mabhodhoro ane ruvara rwakasiyana siyana ari mukabhadhi yemapuranga anoratidza kuti ari muchitoro arikutengeswa.
Imba huru irikuvakwa nezvitinha zvisvuku uye pasi pane zvitinha zvegireyi uye ine denga rine ruvara rutsvuku, uyezve haisati yapera ichiri mukuvakwa.

Mureza unomirira imwe nyika, une ruvara rutsvuku, rwegirinhi nerutsvuku zvekare nechepazasi. Pakati pane ruvara rwegirinhi, pane mufananidzo wemwedzi une ruvara ruchena. Mufananidzo uyu une zvaunomiririra kunyika iyoyo.
Mbira inoratidza kuti ine zvairi kudya yakaita kumira.Mbira iyi ine ruvara rwebhurawuni parutivi. nechepadumbu inoratidza kuti ine ruvara ruchena.nechekumusana ine ruvara rwakasvibira.

Chidziro chamatombo chine maruva akanaka. Icho chidziro chacho chakanaka nekuti zvishoma zvakadaro zvinowanikwa muZimbabwe. Pedyo nacho pane maruva maviri, rimwe rakati kurei rimwe racho richiri diki ese ane tumashizha tudiki uyewo anokura achipfumvudzira achiwanda.

Chivakwa chakavakwa zvakanaka chaizvo chinemakamuri  pasi chozoita mamwe pamusooro . Murikuratidzawo kutii mune zvinhu zvinoitwa umu zvakasiyana siyana. Pamberi Pacho pana ma pavement akagadzirwa zvakanaka uye pakadyarwawo  tsangadzi kuti pange pakashongedzeka.

Wanhu warikufamba waripamberi pezviwako. Zvinenge zviwako zvirimudhorobha. Umwe murume aripati akapfeka chinhu chakatsvukuruka. Panewo arimumashure akapfekawo zvitema. Pavarikufamba pakanyatsogadzirwa.
Michero yamamengo yakaunganidzwa yakawanda. Ineruvara rwegirinhi. Michero iyi irikunekwa imwe ineruvara rweyero nematoto eruvara rutema.

Vanhu vari munhandare vanoratidza  kuti vari pakati pekutamba mutambo, vakapfekawo nhumbi dzinoita kuti vange vachitamba zvakanaka, nhumbi idzi dzakasiyana ruvara kuratidza kuti mapoka maviri ayo ari pamakwikwi nechekunze kwenhandare kurikuratidzawo kuti kutori nezvivakwa zviriko.
Pane marara akaunganidzwa. Uyezve kumashure kune misika miviri nezvitoro  zvakatiwandei zvinotengeswa zvakasiyana siyana kunge hembe.
Purani iyi ndeye imba. Yakanyorwa pachipepa chichena. Yakanyorwawo nezvitsvuku uye inoratidza kuti imba hombe nekuti ine makamuri akawanda.
Pane fafitera riri kuratidzwa. Kunze kwefafitera iri kune motikari iri kubudikira.  Motikari iyi yakatarisa kune juraho. Kunze kwejuraho iri kune dzimba dziriko.

Nzvimbo inamatombo mamwe akaturikidzana mamwe akamira oga. Pozoitawo miti pamwechete nemahuswa nemasora zvirikukura zviripo. Pamusoro pematombo awa pane mbudzi mbiri dzakarara ipapo. Mbudzi dzinovawo mhuka dzinochengetwa pamusha navanhu.
Ruzhowa rwakavakwa nezvitina uye simbi dzineruvara ruchena. Kunze kweruzhowa kune huswa hwakapiswa. Mukati meruzhowa murikuonekwa imba ineruvara ruchena uye matombo maviri akaturikidzana.

Panzvimbo iyi pane miti. Umwe muti uripo ndewerudzi rwemudhorofiya, muti uneminzwa unobaya. Panewo dzimba dzinotaridza kuti dziri munzvimbo yakakomberedzwa newaya. Idzi dzimba dzinowanzokuwanikwa panzvimbo dzakaita sekamba dzemaporisa kana kuti nzvimbo inogara vashandi, vangava vehurumende.
Mugwagwa mukuru unofamba nemotokari dzemhando yakasiyana, dzinosanganisira dziduku nekarori kamwe chete kachena. Parutivi pane miti dzakawanda nedzimba.
Pane rudziro rwe jurawo rwakavakwa nezvidhinha uyezve rwakaiswa masimbi pamusoro. Mukati mejurawo iri mune miti yakasiyana kusanganisira mirefu nemipfupi.
Pane murume akapfeka chivhara muromo nomhuno. Ari kufamba mumugwagwa.  Nechemberi kwake kune motokari iri kufamba mumugwagwa mumwechetewo.  Kumberi mberi kwemunhu uyu kune imba yemudurikidzanwa.

Zvimbuzi zviviri zvineruvara rweyero nerwutsvuku pazasi. Zvimbuzi izvi zvinemikova muviri-muviri. Zviripedyo nemiti mihombe. Panzvimbo ine chimbuzi iyi pane tusora twegirinhi tudiki, pane matombo aripo pamberi.
Nzvimbo iriprdyo nemugwagwa. Irikushandiswa kutengeserwa zvinhu. Pane zvinhu zvakasiyana -siyana zvakarongwa. Zvakarongwa kuitira kuti vanonga vachidarika, vaone chinhu chavanoda ndokubva vatenga.
Mapundo mapenyu ane mashizha matete marefu. Mazhinji acho akadonhera pasi. Kwozotiwo mamwe ari nechekumberi akasimuka.

Munhu akamira arikupfura chinhu nemuseve neuta. Arikuratidza kuti arikuda kuti chinhu ichocho achirove nekuti akadhonza maoko ake uye akaisa simba rake rese. Haana chaakapfeka kumusoro asi pane chinenge chimucheka chirikuoneka chiri pamapendekete ake.
Chanza chemunhu chakabata hove anova anodaidzwa nokunzi mabhirimu. Hombe racho rakabatwa muruoko. Mamwe mabhirimu akatsvetwa pasi.
Mukati memotokari. Mune wairesi  yakabairirwa furashi disiki rine ruvara rutsvuku nerwutema.  Padivi pane tsvimbo mbiri dzinoshandiswa kuchinja magiya emotokari.
Rori reC and J Logistics. Rakamira padivi pomugwagwa. Harina kumira mumugwagwa kuitira kuti dzimwe motokari dzipfuure. Kunze kunoratidza kujeka uye zuva richinyatsopisa zvakanaka.
Mune mumwe mugwagwa wetara une makomba mune mumwe murume akabata pasuru arikufamba. Pedyo naye kune vakadzi vanoita kunge vakaunganira zvinhu zvirikutengeswa.
Varume vatatu, mumwe akapfeka chibhibhi chine ruvara rutsvuku, vamwe vaviri vakapfeka zvibhibhi zvine ruvara rwelaimu, motokari dzakapaka, imwe ine ruvara ruchena
Mapenzura mashanu matsvuku akaputirwa mupepa rebhurandi rebhiki. Bepa iri rinemavara matsvuku, machena neorenji.

Mukati me bhiriji mune shanga dzakareba  dzinomera mumvura dzinemashizha marefu e girinhi ari matete.  Pakati padzo pane miti yemi  banana ine  mashizha akafara  anoita se aka chekwa. Bhiriji rakavakwa nemasimbi,  muzasi maro mune sora rakaoma  nemarara ma pepa.

Motokari mbiri dzirikupesana mumugwagwa unetara. Imwe ineruvara rwebhuru uye imwe ineruvara ruchena. Nechekurutivi panewo kanzira kadiki kanoshandiswa nevanofamba netsoka uye vanenge vayinemabhasikoro.

Chuma chemuhuro nemhete dzemunzeve zvakarongedzwa zvakaisvonaka pachidhori chitsvuku. Zvose ndezverudzi rwedenga. Chemuhuro chakarongedzwa tutanda tutatu tunenge turi pachipfuva chemupfeki zvonobatana  zvoita chuma chimwe chete nechekumashure uye mhete dzemunzeve dzakadzira magonyatatu dzichiyevedza zvikuru.
Munda wakrimwa une ivhu dema kune rumwe rutivi  neivhu dzvuku kune rimwe rutivi, kuri kuonekwa sora rakaoma uye  nechekumberi kune miti yaksvibira.

Imba yomunhurikidzwa yakavakwa zvakanaka zvikuru. Murutivi meimba iyoyi munemotokari dzakapakwa dzineruvara rwakasiyana siyana. Imwe ine ruvara rutsvuku imwe ine ruvara rwesirivha uye imwe ine ruvara richena.
Mugwagwa unofamba nemotokari.  Ghedhi rine ruvara rutema. Mudhuri wejuraworo wakakomberedza zvivakwa.
Shiri yerukodzi imwe chete iri mudenga inombururuka. Yakavhura mapapiro ayo makuru. Ine mavara machena nebhurauni neamwe maduku matema.

Nzvimbo inechivako chirikuita zvekubudira kumusoro. Chivako chacho chine denga rakatsvuka. Chakachengetedzwawo nerusvingo ruripamberi.
Pane kamugwagwa kakaiswa pamberi uye panetumuti twakasimwa pamberi pacho.
Nzvimbo yedhorobha ine vanhu varikufamba. Nechekumberi kuno kuna akaisa chokuvhara muromo achisunda chingoro, nemotokari dzirimumugwagwa. Nechitoro chakavakwa.
Pane mbudzi.Mbudzi iyi ine vana vayo vaviri.Yakamira pamabwe.Kumashure kuneroni yegirini uyezve kune dzimwe mbudzi dzeruvara ruchena

Mumba mekubikira makakoverwa zvekurongedzera ndiro pamadziro. Zvine ruvara ruchena uye zvimwe zvitema. Pane pekuvhura pakawanda uye pamwe pacho pane zvekubatisa vanhu vachivhura. Panewo panosukirwa ndiro pouyawo pari pakati pekuti vanhu vanorongedzera zvinhu kana kumira ipapo vachichekacheka zvimwe zvinhu.
Chitoro chinotengesa zvikafu, pagoni rekupinda pane maCrate matatu epurasitiki ane ruvara ritsvuku ane mabhodhoro ezvekunwa. Panze pane bhinhi guru repurasitiki rakazara nemarara.
Musangano varume vakagara vakaita dzenderedzwa. Vakagara pazvigaro vakapfeka zvimajaketi zvebhuruu. Uyeo vane mabheke pane mumwe ane bepa chena
Bundo kana kuti huswa hukuru hwakandocheneruka rwuchiratidza kuti hahuna hutano zvichibva zvaita kuti tione kuti hwave nenguva refu husina kumbonaiwa nemvura kana kuwana mwando.
Ingwe yakashama muromo wayo. Ine mazino mana ari kwekutanga akareba mamwe acho mapfupi. Ingwe iyi ine madodo matema akazara muviri wayo wose.
Motikari dziri kufamba mumugwagwa unetara. Dzimwewo dzamira, pane dzakamira pane motikari chena poita chimwe chinenge chirori chine ruvara ruchena negireyi nemasimbi kumashure.
Masiripasi ane mavara akasiyana siyana. Anowanzoshandiswa kana vanhu vachienda kundogeza. Vanozomabvisa vachipfeka shangu vanenge vapfeka zvinhu zvavachazofamba nazvo.
Zvidhinha zvakaitwa dutu zvakarongedzwa zvakanaka. Parutivi pane sora rakaoma . Nechekumberi kuri kuoneka dzimba dzakapurasitiwa dzakapfurirwa nemarata.
Pane bindu rine miriwo yakawanda. Muriwo uyu unoita kunge tsunga. Pasi pane mashizha akaoma emuriwo umwe chetewo.
Sango rine miti yakawanda ine mashizha akasvibirira akati ndoo erudzi rweginhi.  Honaiwo zvipukanana zviri pamashizha zverudzi rutema.

Motikari huru dzinoshandiswa paku gadzira mugwagwa dzakamiswa dzakaita mitsetse dzakawanda. Dzakapakwa dzakamiswa dzakadzoswa kumashure. Motokari idzi dzinoshandiswa kutakura ivhu rinoshandiswa kugadzira migwagwa munzvimbo zhinji.
Mbizi mbiri dzkamira dzine ruvara rwekuchena uye neruvara rutema uye nerume ruvara rwebhurauni.

Mukomana akapfeka sikipa yeyero inemaoko mapfupi yakanyorwa pamberi neruvara ruchena, akapfeka mudhebhe mutema akabata tambo chena mumaoko.Kuruoko rwerudyi akapfeka katambo katema akaisa kabheki katema kane masimbi machena muhoro akagara pamudhuri une pamusoro pebhurauni wakaubwa ne zvitinha zvine maburi zvichena.

Mudhorobha mune vanhu vakawanda varikufambamo. Uyewo mune midhuri yakavakwa ichienda mudenga. Iyi midhuri yakapendwa neruvara ruchena. Pavanhu vari kufamba pane murume akabereka bhegi dema anenguwani uye ane chikipa chinemutsetse muchena ne mutsvuku.
Maruva akaisvonaka. Akadyarwa akatevedza fenzi. Ane mashizha ane ruvara rwegirinhi. Maruva anodyarwa kuti ashongedza nzvimbo.
Pamusika panowanikwa vanhu vakawanda vakatakura nhumbi dzakasiyana nezvingoro zvakakunamiswa zvinoshandiswa kutakura nhumbi dzavanhu nemuti murefu refu.
Shiri imwechete hombe yakamhara padanda rakaora.  Ine mapapiro akakura uye ine ruvara rwe bhurauni.  Muromo wayo wakakombama uye wakapinza kunge se munzwa.
Mubhedha unoratidza kuti uchiri mutsva. Wakagadzirwa nemapuranga ukaiswa mutefetefe. Ndokuiswa jira rine ruvara ruchena rakakomberedzwa nejira rine ruvara rutema.

Mugwagwa wakapamhamha unetara.  Mumugwagwa uyu muri kufamba motokari dzemhando  dzakasiyana.   Mujinga macho mune   dzakamira dzakarongwa dzakatarisa rutivi  rumwe dzakatevera mujinga memugwagwa.  Nechekumberi kwacho tiri kuona midhuri mikuru yakanaka inoyevedza.  Zvatiri kuona panzvimbo iyi zvinoratidza kuti nzvimbo iyi iri pakati pedhorobha.
Chikafu chakabikwa zvemhando yepamusoro. Nyama yakaita zvekukangwa parutivi pacho pane machipisi ayo anobikwa nemapotato sezvinoita kuti vanhu vange vachizipirwa vachivaka muviri.
Vanhu vakawarira misika yawo pasi inosanganisira madomasi matsvuku uye mirivo vamwe warikufamba baba varimberi vakabata saga rine zvichena ne zvitsvuku mberi kwazvo kune bepa rebhuruu ririmumugwagwa

Pane gedhi rakavhurika. 
Nechemukati megedhi  
iri pane zvimwe zvidhina zvakarongwa pedyo neimwe imba yemapuranga yakavhurika  gonhi nefafitera.
Shambo mbiri dzeganda dzemhando yenjombo. Dzitema uye dzakasungwa netambo pamusoro. Dzakagadzikwa pasi pane matayira machena.

Zimota remhando retipa rakamira pamberi pechivakwa. Rine ruvara rwutema uye rakanyorwa nezvichena. Rine mavhiri makuru akawanda. Zvakarewo rinoshandiswa kutakura zvinhu zvinorema. Rinogona kusimudzwa richidurura  zvinhu zvirimariri zvoenda pasi.

Pamusika panotaridza kuti panotengeswa mitsvairo. Mitsvairo inogadzirwa nehuswa hunosungwa huri pamwe chete. Hunoshandiswa kutsvaira mumba, Kubvisa tsvina kana kutsvaira paruvazhe. Pane madzimai arikuita basa iri.
Juraworo kana kuti ruzhowa rwemazuva ano.Rwakavakwa nesamende.Uye runowanzowanikwa mumudhorobha ruzhowa urwu.

Ruva rinoyevedza rine mavara akasiyana mamwe akaita pepo nemamwe akatsvukuruka nerumwe rwakandoita rugirini pakati. Ruva iri rinoratidza kuti rinowana mwando wakakwana nemupfudze wakakwana sezvo richinyatsokubwinya.
Nzvimbo inorasirwa marara kumberi kwemarara kunoonekwa mudhuri yakavakwa ine zvidhinha zvitsvuku nezimuti rakasvibira rakati bvuru-bvuru uyewo danda remagetsi.

Svizhira svinoratidza kuti svinofamba veruzhinji vaya vanofamba netsoka. Parutivi pesvizhira izvi pane zviimba zvitoko zvinoratidza kuti maravhatiri kana kuti zvimbuzi.  Dzimwe dzacho dzimba dzakavakwa dzikatadza kuzopendwa uye zhinji dzacho dzakapfurirwa nemazen'e.
munharaunda muna bhirudhin'i amakambani akasiyana siyana.

Munda unoratidza kuti wanga wakarimwa chibage sezvo pakazara majanga anowanikwa pachibage anoratidza kuti pakakohwewa mamwe acho akatopiswa, nechokunerumwe rutivi kuratidza ruzhowa rwakakomberedza musha. Pamusha apa pane dzimba dzakasiyana, dzimwe dzakapurasitiwa dzimwe hadzina.

Baba varikufamba mumugwaga vari pachimudhudhudhu. Vane ngowani tsvuku. Vakatakura bhokisi rine ruvara rwe goridhe. Kumashure kwavo kune motokari mbiri. Imwe ine ruvara rwesirivha imwe ine ruvara ruchena. Kudivi kune madzimai varikufamba vakananga kudhorobha. Amai varikumashure vakabereka mwana.

Mazuva ano kwava nezvidavado zvemidziyo yekumwira hwahwa.Iyi ikomichi inoshandiswa kumwirwa hwahwa nevanhu vanenge vakabudirira.Makarekare vanhu vaishandisa mikombe kumwira hwahwa asi iye zvino nekuda kwechirungu chakauya vanhu vava kushandisa komichi dzemagirazi.
Kombi ine ruvara rweyero iri kufamba iri mumugwagwa. Padivi pane chitoro chePick n Pay chinoratidza kuti chitoro ichi chine zvimwe zvivakwa zvakaturikidzana  zviri padenga,  zvinoenda mudenga denga.
Motikari ine ruvara rwegireyi rwakasvibira.Kumusana kwayo yakabereka vhiri rine ruvara rutema rwakanyorwa nezvichena uye pakati pevhiri pane ruvara rwesirivha.
Nzvimbo iri kuratidza kuti haina huswa ine tushoma-shoma.Uyezve inoratidza sekuti inotsikwa zvakanyanya nevanhu kana kuti nemhuka.Ndokusaka pasina kumera huswa huri kukura hwuchienda mudenga.
Miti mihombe iyo inepazi akasiyana iriparitivi pemugwagwa apo panofamba panemotokari, dzimwe dzichipinda mudhorobha dzimwe dzichibuda zvinoita kuti mabhizimusi ange achifamba achienda mberi.

Mugwagwa uri mudhorobha murikufamba motokari dzemhando dzakasiyana dzinemavara anosanganisira mapfumbu nemachena uye nedzimwe dzakamira kumacheto kwemugwagwa. Vanhu varikufamba vamwe vakatakura vana nezvivakwa zvihombe zvirikunze kwemugwagwa.

Nzvimbo inokwirirwa mabhazi muguta. Vanhu varikufamba vachitsvaka mabhazi okukwira uye vamwe vakamira vakatarisa mabhazi aya. Bhazi riri kumashure rine ruvara ruchena, rutsvuku uye ruvara rwebhurauni muviri waro. Rine mafafitera ane ruvara rutema.
Pane imwe nzvimbo inoita semusika, pana amai varikutengesa mabhegi. Pedyo naamai ava kune mumwe munhu akabereka bhegi rake. Mabhegi aya ane mavara akasiyana, kusanganisira rimwe dema.
Munhandare munoonekwa vatsigiri vachiimba nokufara vachisumudza mureza wenyika yeZimbabwe. Vamwewo vakabata zvinyorwa vamwe ndivo vanojaivha vachiimba.

Migwagwa mikuru yakapamhamha ine tara,uri mhiri nemhiri.  Migwagwa iyi ine motokari dzinofamba dzichienda mativi akasiyana .  Mumwe wacho uri nechekumberi une motokari zhinji dzine mizera yakasiyana nemakara akasiyana. Dzimwe ichena ,dzimwe ítema, dzimwe itsvuku .  Nechekumberi kwacho tirikuona chivakwa chikuru chakazara magirazi zvinobva zvaita kuti tizive kuti nzvimbo iyi iri mudhorobha.

Nzvimbo ine miti namatombo.Pane miti yakawanda yakabatana.Miti iyi ina mashizha ane ruvara rwegirini nechekuzasi kune zidombo riripo rine ruvara rwakachenerukira nechekurutivi kunoratidza kuti kune huswa ,uswa uhwu hwakachenerukira zvakare.
Shangu imwe chete yerutivi rwerudyi yakasungwa tambo ineruvara rutema zvakare yakavharika.
Mumba mune masitepisi machena ane mapuranga ekubatirira akagadzirwa nemiti.
Mbudzi irikufamba . Mbudzi iyi ine ruvara ruchena nechekumusoro ine ruvara rutsvuku , ine muswe une ruvara rwebhurawuni .Mbudzi inonaka uye nyama yachona haina kunyatsoomarara.
Pane mugwagwa wetara. Kumativi kwemugwagwa uyu kune miti yakasiyana. Imwe miti ine mashizha akasvibira kozoita isina. Pedyo nemiti iyi pane marambi emugwagwa.
Shanga dzakawanda. Mukati meshanga muri kuonekwa muti womubhanana une mashizha akaita yero. Parutivi parikuonekwa miti mirefu ine mashizha akasvibira.
